content.value_statement: Paid ad teams need many compliant creative variations, but manual writing is slow. This skill generates grounded ad copy, concepts, and iteration reports by platform.
actual_capabilities: Generates headlines, descriptions, and primary text for major paid ad platforms.
Checks copy against platform character limits and format expectations.
Analyzes supplied performance data to identify winning and losing creative patterns.
Organizes variations by angle, audience intent, and test objective.
Creates grounded static ad concepts from winning ads, reviews, and comments.
Documents iteration logs with patterns, retired angles, and new test ideas.
limitations: Requires product, audience, offer, and platform context for useful output.
Does not replace campaign strategy, budget planning, or targeting work.
Image, video, and voice generation require separate tools and user credentials.
Users must verify claims, testimonials, disclosures, and platform compliance.

use_cases.title: Launch Search Ad Variations
use_cases.description: Create Google Ads headlines and descriptions that fit RSA limits and cover multiple angles.

use_cases.title: Build Static Social Concepts
use_cases.description: Turn real reviews, comments, and winning ads into sourced static ad concepts for designers.

use_cases.title: Iterate From Performance Data
use_cases.description: Review top and bottom performers, then generate new variations that test clear hypotheses.

prompt_templates.title: Create First Ad Set
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a new paid ad campaign.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create paid ad copy for this product: [product]. Platform: [platform]. Audience: [audience]. Offer: [offer]. Give 5 angles with headlines and descriptions.

prompt_templates.title: Adapt Copy by Platform
prompt_templates.scenario: Convert one campaign idea into channel-specific creative.
prompt_templates.prompt: Adapt this campaign idea for Google Ads, Meta, LinkedIn, and TikTok: [campaign idea]. Keep each variation within platform limits.

prompt_templates.title: Iterate From Results
prompt_templates.scenario: Use performance data to improve existing ads.
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze these ad results: [paste metrics]. Identify winning patterns, losing patterns, and create 12 new variations with a test rationale.

prompt_templates.title: Build Grounded Static Batch
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for source-grounded static ad production.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use these winning ads, reviews, comments, and brand notes: [sources]. Create 30 static ad concepts with template names, copy, visual direction, and source grounding.

output_examples.input: A project management SaaS needs Google Ads copy for a free trial launch.
output: Angle: reduce manual status updates. Headlines include short benefit-led options under 30 characters.
Descriptions connect the free trial to faster project visibility and fewer meetings.
The response flags one headline that exceeds the limit and provides a shorter replacement.

output_examples.input: A DTC brand provides reviews and wants Meta static ad concepts.
output: Concepts are grouped by template, such as review card, before-after, and objection breaker.
Each concept includes a headline, body copy, visual direction, and the review source.
The batch avoids invented claims and marks any claim that needs proof.

output_examples.input: A marketer shares CTR and conversion data from recent ads.
output: The report identifies common themes in the best performers and weak patterns in the lowest performers.
New variations reuse proven hooks while testing two new angles.
The iteration notes list what to pause, keep, and test next.

best_practices: Provide product positioning, audience details, offer terms, and platform before asking for variations.
Supply real reviews, comments, and winning ads when requesting static ad concepts.
Review every claim, testimonial, and disclosure before publishing creative.
anti_patterns: Do not ask for high-volume creative without source material or brand context.
Do not use generated statistics, testimonials, or social proof without verification.
Do not mix campaign strategy, budget allocation, and creative generation in one vague request.

faq.question: Which ad platforms does this skill support?
faq.answer: It covers Google Ads, Meta, LinkedIn, TikTok, Twitter/X, display, static social, and video concept formats.

faq.question: Can it create visual ads?
faq.answer: It can write static ad concepts and image prompts. Actual image generation needs a separate image tool.

faq.question: Can it use performance data?
faq.answer: Yes. Paste CSV data, tables, or API output so it can find winning and losing creative patterns.

faq.question: Does it manage ad campaigns?
faq.answer: No. It focuses on creative generation and iteration, not targeting, budgets, bidding, or campaign setup.

faq.question: How does it reduce hallucinated claims?
faq.answer: It asks for grounded inputs and tells users not to invent stats, testimonials, or proof points.

faq.question: Does it work with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The report marks support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code compatible workflows.
